ud3.3:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
ud3.3:1.3: tena kho pana samayena yasojappamukhāni pañcamattāni bhikkhusatāni sāvatthiṃ anuppattāni honti bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
ud3.3:1.4: te ca āgantukā bhikkhū nevāsikehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodamānā senāsanāni paññāpayamānā pattacīvarāni paṭisāmayamānā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā ahesuṃ.
ud3.3:2.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
ud3.3:2.2: ke panete ānanda uccāsaddā mahāsaddā kevaṭṭā maññe macchavilopeti.
ud3.3:2.3: etāni bhante yasojappamukhāni pañcamattāni bhikkhusatāni sāvatthiṃ anuppattāni bhagavantaṃ dassanāya
ud3.3:2.4: te ca āgantukā bhikkhū nevāsikehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodamānā senāsanāni paññāpayamānā pattacīvarāni paṭisāmayamānā uccāsaddā mahāsaddāti.
ud3.3:2.5: tena hānanda mama vacanena te bhikkhū āmantehi
ud3.3:3.1: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā yena te bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavoca
ud3.3:3.3: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhū bhagavā etadavoca
ud3.3:4.1: kinnu tumhe bhikkhave uccāsaddā mahāsaddā kevaṭṭā maññe macchavilopeti.
ud3.3:4.2: evaṃ vutte āyasmā yasojo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
ud3.3:4.3: imāni bhante pañcamattāni bhikkhusatāni sāvatthiṃ anuppattāni bhagavantaṃ dassanāya
ud3.3:4.4: teme āgantukā bhikkhū nevāsikehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodamānā senāsanāni paññāpayamānā pattacīvarāni paṭisāmayamānā uccāsaddā mahāsaddāti.
ud3.3:4.5: gacchatha bhikkhave vo paṇāmemi na vo mama santike vatthabbanti.
ud3.3:5.1: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā senāsanaṃ paṭisāmetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena vajjī tena cārikaṃ pakkamiṃsu
ud3.3:5.2: vajjīsu anupubbena cārikañcaramānā yena vaggumudānadī tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā vaggumudānadītīre paṇṇakuṭiyo karitvā vassaṃ upagacchiṃsu.
ud3.3:6.1: atha kho āyasmā yasojo vassūpagato bhikkhū āmantesi
ud3.3:6.2: bhagavatā mayaṃ āvuso paṇāmitā atthakāmena hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya
ud3.3:6.3: handa mayaṃ āvuso tathā vihāraṃ kappema yathā no viharataṃ bhagavā atthakāmo assāti.
ud3.3:6.4: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato yasojassa paccassosuṃ.
ud3.3:6.5: atha kho te bhikkhū vūpakaṭṭhā appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharantā tenevantaravassena sabbe yeva tisso vijjā sacchākaṃsu.
ud3.3:7.1: atha kho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena vesālī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi
ud3.3:7.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
ud3.3:8.1: atha kho bhagavā vaggumudātīriyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ cetasā ceto paricca manasikaritvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
ud3.3:8.2: ālokajātā viya me ānanda esā disā obhāsajātā viya me ānanda esā disā
ud3.3:8.3: yassaṃ disāyaṃ vaggumudātīriyā bhikkhū viharanti gantuṃ appaṭikkūlāsi me manasikātuṃ
ud3.3:8.4: pahiṇeyyāsi tvaṃ ānanda vaggumudātīriyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ
ud3.3:8.5: satthā āyasmante āmanteti satthā āyasmantānaṃ dassanakāmoti.
ud3.3:9.1: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā yena aññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
ud3.3:9.2: ehi tvaṃ āvuso yena vaggumudātīriyā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā vaggumudātīriye bhikkhū evaṃ vadehi
ud3.3:9.3: satthā āyasmante āmanteti satthā āyasmantānaṃ dassanakāmoti.
ud3.3:10.1: evamāvusoti kho so bhikkhu āyasmato ānandassa paṭissutvā
ud3.3:10.2: seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evamevaṃ mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ antarahito vaggumudāya nadiyā tīre tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ purato pāturahosi.
ud3.3:10.3: atha kho so bhikkhu vaggumudātīriye bhikkhū etadavoca
ud3.3:10.4: satthā āyasmante āmanteti satthā āyasmantānaṃ dassanakāmoti.
ud3.3:11.1: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā senāsanaṃ paṭisāmetvā pattacīvaramādāya
ud3.3:11.2: seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evamevaṃ vaggumudāya nadiyā tīre antarahitā mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ bhagavato sammukhe pāturahaṃsu.
ud3.3:11.3: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā āneñjena samādhinā nisinno hoti.
ud3.3:11.5: katamena nu kho bhagavā vihārena etarahi viharatīti.
ud3.3:11.7: āneñjena kho bhagavā vihārena etarahi viharatīti.
ud3.3:12.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā nikkhante paṭhame yāme uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ katvā yena bhagavā tenañjalimpaṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
ud3.3:12.2: abhikkantā bhante ratti nikkhanto paṭhamo yāmo ciranisinnā āgantukā bhikkhū
ud3.3:13.1: dutiyampi kho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā nikkhante majjhime yāme uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ katvā yena bhagavā tenañjalimpaṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
ud3.3:14.1: tatiyampi kho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā nikkhante pacchime yāme uddhaste aruṇe nandimukhiyā rattiyā uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ katvā yena bhagavā tenañjalimpaṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
ud3.3:15.1: atha kho bhagavā tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhahitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
ud3.3:15.2: sace kho tvaṃ ānanda jāneyyāsi ettakampi te na
ud3.3:15.3: paṭibhāseyya ahañcānanda imāni ca pañcabhikkhusatāni sabbeva āneñjasamādhinā nisinnāti.
ud3.3:16.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi
